name: smwmusic-mario-luigi-bowser-s-inside-story-in-the-final
title: Mario & Luigi: Bowser's Inside Story - In The Final
description:
"In The Final" or "The Grand Finale" is the final boss theme song of Mario & Luigi: Bowser's Inside Story, used for the battle against Dark Bowser and the Dark Star Core.

I had ported this song for the Super Famicompo 4 contest, where it placed 36th out of 58.

EDIT (2023/01/08):
- wrong note fixed
- volume of synth slightly increased
